dataset_description: Dealer-level purchase performance against target for the latest three reporting months including actual purchase value, target value, target gap, and achievement percentage.

M1_Actual.description: Actual purchase revenue for the latest reporting month (Current Date - 2 Months).

M1_Target.description: Target purchase revenue for the latest reporting month.

M1_Gap_EUR.description: M1_Actual minus M1_Target. Positive = exceeded target, Negative = missed target.

M1_AchvPct.description: Purchase target achievement percentage for the latest reporting month.

M2_Actual.description: Actual purchase revenue for the middle reporting month (Current Date - 3 Months).

M2_Target.description: Target purchase revenue for the middle reporting month.

M2_AchvPct.description: Purchase target achievement percentage for the middle reporting month.

M3_Actual.description: Actual purchase revenue for the oldest reporting month (Current Date - 4 Months).

M3_Target.description: Target purchase revenue for the oldest reporting month.

M3_AchvPct.description: Purchase target achievement percentage for the oldest reporting month.

trend_analysis_logic.latest_month_priority: Always prioritize M1 analysis — M1 is the most recent reporting month.

llm_instructions: Treat M1 as the most important month — it represents the most recent reporting period.
Always start the insight using M1 purchase performance.
Compare M1 against M2 and M3 to determine improvement or deterioration trends.
Use M1_Gap_EUR and M1_AchvPct as primary insight drivers.
Use M2 and M3 primarily for trend analysis.
Highlight dealers consistently exceeding purchase targets.
Highlight dealers consistently missing purchase targets.
Highlight improving or deteriorating achievement percentages.
Highlight widening or narrowing target gaps.
Support every statement with actual metric values.
Do not invent business reasons, market causes, supply chain issues, customer behaviour, or operational explanations.
If M1_AchvPct > 100, describe the dealer as exceeding purchase target.
If M1_AchvPct < 100, describe the dealer as below purchase target.
If M1_AchvPct = 100, describe the dealer as exactly meeting purchase target.
Prioritize recent performance over older historical performance.
Use actual month names in the narrative and never use M1, M2, or M3.
Generate concise business-focused insights suitable for a sales representative preparing for a dealer discussion.
